about: T-18 P2, the follower daemon (2026-10-20): A on it. The line for its friendship (0, 70, 120, 150, 255: the five readings), then one mood when one holds -- the watch (night, dusk, dawn), the sky (rain, a thunderstorm, snow, fog, wind), the season (winter, spring, summer, autumn), the place (HALFTONE, THE NEXUS), and a hidden item two tiles off; indoors, the friendship line alone. Each mood is talked to twice, since its two lines take turns. The watch, sky and season are the DEBUG overrides (gDaemonsWatchOverride, gDaemonsWeatherOverride, gDaemonsSeasonOverride), poked; a sky takes a map load, so each sky stop starts with a goto. Every word is DRAFT (data/scripts/follower.inc).

stops.stop: friendship: its five readings, on ROUTE 1 by day under a clear autumn sky
steps: says "is a step behind. It is watching the way out."
says "keeps the distance you set. No closer."
says "stays near you without being told."
says "would not leave if you opened the box."
says "stops to turn over a leaf."
says "is listening to the leaves under its feet."
says "keeps closer once the light goes."
says "looks back the way you came."
says "shakes the rain off its casing."
says "is counting the drops that land on it."
says "counts the gap between the light and the sound."
says "walks a little closer while it thunders."
says "leaves a second line of prints beside yours."
says "watches the snow fill in its tracks."
says "stays where it can still see you."
says "is listening for what it cannot see."
says "leans into the wind when you do."
says "turns its back to the wind and waits for you."

stops.stop: the season: winter, spring, summer (autumn was the first stop)
steps: says "stops at everything that is new."
says "sniffs at the grass, then at you."
says "walks slower in the heat. So do you."
says "looks the same as it did. Everything else does not."
says "keeps checking that you are still you."
says "stands very still, as if it might dry that way."
